summary: Added a narrow repair mode that restores organization links in an accepted V4 bundle without discarding model-assisted events.
issues: Rebuilding today's bundle without the workflow-only model-assist snapshot would remove accepted events
risks: Repair mode must remain limited to events with empty entity references and source-visible known aliases
lessons: Targeted recovery must preserve accepted model-assisted event rows when their transient proposal snapshot is not published
reusable_rules: Use repair-existing-entity-links for accepted bundles instead of a lossy full rebuild
